acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AEO is highly effective for local targeting, especially in competitive markets like New York City or Los Angeles. By optimizing your content to answer location-specific queries, such as 'best pool builders in Los Angeles' or 'inground pool costs NYC', you increase your chances of appearing in local search results and answer features. This means explicitly including city names in your content where relevant, ensuring your Google My Business profile is optimized, and creating content that addresses regional considerations like climate or specific building codes. This focused approach helps connect you with local customers actively seeking your services.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, AEO significantly helps pool businesses attract customers in specific cities like New York City or Los Angeles by optimizing for location-based search queries and local search features.
